title: CtlGatewayStatus
description: `GET /v1/gateway`: the published generation and whether the registry has moved past it. The ctl writes only untracked generated files under `/rag/data/ctl/gateway/gen-<n>/` and publishes them by switching two stable include symlinks (`05-tenants.generated.conf`, `tenants-ui-static.generated.conf`); `txn.json` is the durable record of the last switch and `txn_state` tells whether it completed. `pending_diff: true` means `POST /v1/gateway/render` would produce a non-empty diff.

generation.description: The published gateway generation; 0 before the first publish.

registry_generation.description: The registry generation the published gateway generation was rendered from.

config_ok.description: Result of the last staged `nginx -t`; null when never run.

routes.description: The rows of the generated `$tenant_api` / `$tenant_ui` / `$tenant_readonly` maps, from the registry.

status.description: What the gateway is told to expect: `active` (health probed 200), `maintenance` (declared 502), `retired`.
